Our Services

Complete Logistics Solutions
Built for Nigeria

From last-mile express delivery to full-scale international freight — we've built Nigeria's most comprehensive logistics network.

Express Delivery

Same-day and next-day delivery for time-sensitive parcels across all major Nigerian cities. We move faster so your business never pauses.

Get Quote →
Freight Transport

Bulk cargo and heavy freight moved safely across state lines with our modern fleet of trucks, trailers, and refrigerated vehicles.

Get Quote →
Warehouse Storage

Secure, climate-controlled warehouse facilities in strategic Nigerian locations. Store, sort, and dispatch inventory on your schedule.

Get Quote →
Nationwide Dispatch

Dedicated dispatch riders covering every state in Nigeria. Fast urban deliveries with real-time GPS tracking and proof of delivery.

International Shipping

Import and export services linking Nigeria to the world. Customs clearance, air freight, and sea cargo handled with precision.

Full-suite logistics management for SMEs and enterprises — supply chain optimization, distribution networks, and dedicated account management.

Behind every delivery is a team of trained logistics professionals who take their work seriously. Our operations staff, dispatch coordinators, and field agents are certified, background-checked, and held to the highest standards of professionalism.

Every Crown Shine team member goes through rigorous onboarding — from safety protocols and handling procedures to customer service training — because we believe the people behind the process are what make logistics truly reliable.

Our Story

Simplifying Logistics
Across Africa

Crown Shine Logistics was born from a simple frustration — Nigerian businesses were losing time, money, and customers to unreliable delivery systems. We set out to build something different: a logistics company that combines the warmth of personal service with the efficiency of cutting-edge technology.

Founded in Ibadan, we've grown from a local dispatch company into a pan-Nigerian logistics powerhouse, with operations spanning all 36 states and growing international freight capabilities. Our mission is clear — to make logistics invisible. When you trust Crown Shine, your shipments simply arrive.

Our Vision: To become Africa's most trusted and technologically advanced logistics network by 2030.

Reliability First

Every system we build centers on one promise — your delivery arrives.

Tech-Powered

Real-time GPS, digital POD, and AI routing put you in full control.

Pan-African Vision

Nigeria is our foundation. Africa is our destination.

Client-Centric

Every decision we make starts and ends with our clients' success.
